fields.description: Maximum number of pages a single crawl can read.
fields.label: Maximum pages

fields.description: Maximum number of links followed away from the start page.
fields.label: Maximum depth

fields.description: Maximum number of redirects followed for a single page.
fields.label: Maximum redirects

fields.description: Number of pages read at the same time. Sites that set a Crawl-delay in robots.txt are read one page at a time.
fields.label: Concurrent requests

fields.description: Time to wait before each batch of pages. If a site's robots.txt sets a longer Crawl-delay, that is used instead, up to 30 seconds.
fields.label: Delay between batches (seconds)

fields.description: A crawl stops after running for this long.
fields.label: Maximum crawl time (minutes)

fields.description: Time allowed to download a single page.
fields.label: Page timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Pages larger than this are skipped.
fields.label: Maximum page size (MB)

fields.description: Time allowed to download a single sitemap or llms.txt file.
fields.label: Sitemap timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Sitemaps and llms.txt files larger than this are skipped.
fields.label: Maximum sitemap size (MB)

fields.description: Links whose URL or anchor text contains a keyword are read first. Used by crawls that do not set their own.
fields.label: Link priority

fields.description: URLs that match any of these regular expressions are skipped. Enter one per line. Used by crawls that do not set their own.
fields.label: Skip patterns

fields.description: Name sent to websites with every request. robots.txt rules are matched against it.
fields.label: User agent

fields.description: Skip pages that a site's robots.txt does not allow.
fields.label: Respect robots.txt

fields.description: If set, only these domains and their subdomains can be crawled.
fields.label: Allowed domains

fields.description: These domains and their subdomains are never crawled, even if listed in Allowed domains.
fields.label: Blocked domains
